arxiv-1705-01209.title: Lifelong Metric Learning
arxiv-1705-01209.creator: Gan Sun, Yang Cong, Ji Liu, Xiaowei Xu
arxiv-1705-01209.description: Abstract The state-of-the-art online learning approaches are only capable of learning the metric for predefined tasks. In this paper, we consider lifelong learning problem to mimic “human learning”, i.e., endowing a new capability to the learned metric for a new task from new online samples and incorporating previous experiences and knowledge.

arxiv-2101-00223.title: Pricing Spread Option with Liquidity Adjustments Thanks: Preprint.
arxiv-2101-00223.creator: Kevin S. Zhang, Traian A. Pirvu
arxiv-2101-00223.description: Abstract We study the pricing and hedging of European spread options on correlated assets when, in contrast to the standard framework and consistent with imperfect liquidity markets, the trading in the stock market has a direct impact on stocks prices.

arxiv-2207-08323.title: PlaneSDF-based Change Detection for Long-term Dense Mapping
arxiv-2207-08323.creator: Jiahui Fu, Chengyuan Lin, Yuichi Taguchi, Andrea Cohen, Yifu Zhang, Stephen Mylabathula, John J. Leonard
arxiv-2207-08323.description: Abstract The ability to process environment maps across multiple sessions is critical for robots operating over extended periods of time. Specifically, it is desirable for autonomous agents to detect changes amongst maps of different sessions so as to gain a conflict-free understanding of the current environment.

arxiv-2305-08575.title: Fission and fusion of heavy nuclei induced by the passage of a radiation-mediated shock in BNS mergers Fission and fusion of heavy nuclei induced by the passage of a radiation-mediated shock in BNS mergers – B
arxiv-2305-08575.creator: Alon Granot, Amir Levinson, Ehud Nakar
arxiv-2305-08575.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Alon Granot, Amir Levinson, Ehud Nakar. We compute the structure of a Newtonian, multi-ion radiation-mediated shock (RMS) for different compositions anticipated in various stellar explosions. We use a multifluid RMS model that incorporates electrostatic coupling between the different plasma constituents as well as Coulomb friction in a self-consistent manner, and approximates the effect of pair creation and the presence of free neutrons in the shock upstream on the shock structure.

arxiv-2310-09376.title: The Debris of the “Last Major Merger” is Dynamically Young Numpy ( Harris et al. 2020 ) , Scipy ( Virtanen et al. 2020 ) , Astropy ( Astropy Collaboration et al. 2022 ) , Matplotlib ( Hunter 2007 ) , Gizmo ( Hopkins 2015 ) , Agama ( Vasiliev 2018 ) , Gala ( Price-Whelan 2017 ) , Mwahpy ( Donlon 2023
arxiv-2310-09376.creator: Thomas Donlon II, Heidi Jo Newberg, Robyn Sanderson, Emily Bregou, Danny Horta, Arpit Arora, Nondh Panithanpaisal
arxiv-2310-09376.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Thomas Donlon II, Heidi Jo Newberg, Robyn Sanderson, Emily Bregou, Danny Horta, Arpit Arora, Nondh Panithanpaisal. The Milky Way’s (MW) inner stellar halo contains an [Fe/H]-rich component with highly eccentric orbits, often referred to as the “last major merger.” Hypotheses for the origin of this component include Gaia -Sausage/Enceladus (GSE), where the progenitor collided with the MW proto-disk 8-11 Gyr ago, and the Virgo Radial Merger (VRM), where the progenitor collided with the MW disk within the last 3 Gyr.

arxiv-2312-10615.title: A Symmetric Multigrid-Preconditioned Krylov Subspace Solver for Stokes Equations
arxiv-2312-10615.creator: Yutian Tao, Eftychios Sifakis
arxiv-2312-10615.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Yutian Tao, Eftychios Sifakis. Numerical solution of discrete PDEs corresponding to saddle point problems is highly relevant to physical systems such as Stokes flow. However, scaling up numerical solvers for such systems is often met with challenges in efficiency and convergence. Multigrid is an approach with excellent applicability to elliptic problems such as the Stokes equations, and can be a solution to such challenges of scalability and efficiency.

arxiv-2408-14280.title: Hydrostatic mass of galaxy clusters within some theories of gravity
arxiv-2408-14280.creator: Feri Apryandi, M. Lawrence Pattersons
arxiv-2408-14280.description: Abstract The mass of galaxy clusters (GCs) can be determined by calculating the hydrostatic equilibrium equation. In this work, we derive the hydrostatic mass of GCs within Eddington-inspired Born-Infeld (EiBI) theory, beyond Horndeski gravity (BHG), and modified emergent Newtonian gravity (MENG) with generalized uncertainty principle (GUP) correction. We apply the formulations on the masses of 10 GCs.

arxiv-2501-09530.title: Make yourself comfortable: Nudging urban heat and noise mitigation with smartwatch-based Just-in-time Adaptive Interventions (JITAI) Journal: Building and Environment
arxiv-2501-09530.creator: Clayton Miller, Yun Xuan Chua, Matias Quintana, Binyu Lei, Filip Biljecki, Mario Frei
arxiv-2501-09530.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Clayton Miller, Yun Xuan Chua, Matias Quintana, Binyu Lei, Filip Biljecki, Mario Frei. Humans can play a more active role in improving their comfort in the built environment if given the right information at the right place and time. This paper outlines the use of Just-in-Time Adaptive Interventions (JITAI) implemented in the context of the built environment to provide information that helps humans minimize the impact of heat and noise on their daily lives. This framework builds upon the open-source Cozie iOS smartwatch platform.

arxiv-2504-04613.title: SiameseDuo++: Active Learning from Data Streams with Dual Augmented Siamese Networks Note: This paper was supported by the European Research Council (ERC) under grant agreement No 951424 (Water-Futures), the European Union’s Horizon 2020 research and innovation programme under grant agreement No 739
arxiv-2504-04613.creator: Kleanthis Malialis, Stylianos Filippou, Christos G. Panayiotou, Marios M. Polycarpou
arxiv-2504-04613.description: Abstract Data stream mining, also known as stream learning, is a growing area which deals with learning from high-speed arriving data. Its relevance has surged recently due to its wide range of applicability, such as, critical infrastructure monitoring, social media analysis, and recommender systems.

arxiv-2506-11437.title: Social Networks: Enumerating Maximal Community Patterns in c c -Closed Graphs Thanks: University of Waterloo, ON, Canada Email: gbourla@uwaterloo.ca Thanks: Duke University, NC, USA Email: kai.wang@duke.edu Thanks: Duke University, NC, USA Email: fan.wei@duke.edu Thanks: Duke University, NC, USA Ema
arxiv-2506-11437.creator: Gabriela Bourla, Kaixin Wang, Fan Wei, Runtian Zhou
arxiv-2506-11437.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Gabriela Bourla, Kaixin Wang, Fan Wei, Runtian Zhou. Fox, Seshadhri, Roughgarden, Wei, and Wein [ 13 ] introduced the model of c c -closed graphs—a distribution-free model motivated by triadic closure, one of the most pervasive structural signatures of social networks. While enumerating maximal cliques in general graphs can take exponential time, it is known that in c c -closed graphs, maximal cliques and maximal complete bipartite subgraphs can always be enumerated in polynomial time.

arxiv-2510-05482.title: ATOM: A Pretrained Neural Operator for Multitask Molecular Dynamics
arxiv-2510-05482.creator: Luke Thompson ​, Davy Guan ​, Dai Shi ​, Slade Matthews ​ ​, Junbin Gao ​ ​, Andi Han ​
arxiv-2510-05482.description: Abstract Molecular dynamics (MD) simulations underpin modern computational drug discovery, materials science, and biochemistry. Recent machine learning models provide high-fidelity MD predictions without the need to repeatedly solve quantum mechanical forces, enabling significant speedups over conventional pipelines. Yet many such methods typically enforce strict equivariance and rely on sequential rollouts, thus limiting their flexibility and simulation efficiency.

pmc-10674604.description: Klebsiella pneumoniae is a threat to public health due to its continued evolution. In this study, we investigated the evolution, convergence, and transmission of hypervirulent and multi-drug resistant (MDR) clones of K. pneumoniae within healthcare facilities in Uganda. There was high resistance to piperacillin (90.91%), cefuroxime (86.96%), ceftazidime (84.62%), cefotaxime (84.00%), amoxicillin/clavulanate (75%), nalidixic acid (73.68%), and nitrofurantoin (71.

pmc-10710704.title: Targeting the Endothelin-1 pathway to reduce invasion and chemoresistance in gallbladder cancer cells
pmc-10710704.creator: Francisco Rodas, Jetzabel A. Vidal-Vidal, Daniela Herrera, David A. Brown-Brown, Diego Vera, Joaquín Veliz, Pilar Püschel, José I. Erices, Verónica Sánchez Hinojosa, Julio C. Tapia, Eduardo Silva-Pavez, Claudia Quezada-Monrás, Pablo Mendoza-Soto, Flavio Salazar-Onfray, Cristian Carrasco, Ignacio Nie
pmc-10710704.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundGallbladder cancer (GBC) is a prevalent and deadly biliary tract carcinoma, often diagnosed at advanced stages with limited treatment options. The 5-year survival rate varies widely from 4 to 60%, mainly due to differences in disease stage detection. With only a small fraction of patients having resectable tumors and a high incidence of metastasis, advanced GBC stages are characterized by significant chemoresistance.

pmc-11356170.title: Perovskite versus Standard Photodetectors
pmc-11356170.creator: Antoni Rogalski, Weida Hu, Fang Wang, Yang Wang, Piotr Martyniuk
pmc-11356170.description: Perovskites have been largely implemented into optoelectronics as they provide several advantages such as long carrier diffusion length, high absorption coefficient, high carrier mobility, shallow defect levels and finally, high crystal quality. The brisk technological development of perovskite devices is connected to their relative simplicity, high-efficiency processing and low production cost.

pmc-11430834.title: Economic Evaluation of Remote Monitoring for Implantable Cardiac Devices: Evidence from a Remote-Care Study
pmc-11430834.creator: Hannah Bae, YouMi Hwang
pmc-11430834.description: BackgroundThe adoption of remote monitoring (RM) is especially relevant for patients with implantable cardiac devices due to their high risk of hospitalization and the need for frequent outpatient visits. Though RM can help with early detection of cardiac episodes, it may also increase the number of tasks healthcare providers engage in to monitor patients’ health.

pmc-11585972.title: Patient-Reported Outcomes of Pain, Stiffness, and Fatigue Reduction in Rheumatoid and Psoriatic Arthritis With Cannabinoid Use
pmc-11585972.creator: Richa Purohit, Reanne Mathai, Kathlyn Camargo Macias, Sweta Chalise, Tara Jehu, Neha Bhaskar, Neha Bhanusali
pmc-11585972.description: Rheumatoid arthritis (RA) and psoriatic arthritis (PsA) are autoimmune conditions that can progressively destroy joints, causing chronic, often debilitating pain, and drastically affecting the quality of life. Novel pharmaceutical remedies have recently been developed, which allow for better symptom management. However, the complex pain experienced is challenging to control fully, leading this patient population to seek alternative treatments.

pmc-11604008.title: A comprehensive analysis of in-hospital adverse events after scopolamine administration: insights from a retrospective cohort study using a large nationwide inpatient database
pmc-11604008.creator: George Sun, Marc C Torjman, Kevin J Min
pmc-11604008.description: BackgroundScopolamine is a widely used antiemetic in anesthetic practice, particularly for postoperative and post-discharge nausea and vomiting. Despite its frequent usage and recognized efficacy, concerns have emerged regarding the potential for increased side effects, particularly in elderly patients. Further research is needed to assess safety and determine age thresholds for adverse events.

pmc-12429512.title: Visual Snow Syndrome: Therapeutic Implications
pmc-12429512.creator: Kenneth J Ciuffreda, Daniella Rutner, Paulo Fernandes
pmc-12429512.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Visual snow and its syndrome represent a relatively new and enigmatic neurological condition affecting the human sensory, motor, and perceptual systems. In this narrative review, first an overview of the condition and its basic characteristics and demographics are presented.

pmc-12592180.title: A pilot evaluation of the Baby Social ABCs caregiver-mediated intervention for 6–15-month-olds with early signs of autism—feasibility, acceptability, and preliminary evidence
pmc-12592180.creator: E. Dowds, S. MacWilliam, A. Solish, S. Osten, L. Zwaigenbaum, I. M. Smith, J. A. Brian
pmc-12592180.description: BackgroundAutism spectrum disorder (autism) is a neurodevelopmental condition with a high prevalence of approximately 1 in 50 children. Early intervention can support long-term outcomes. Caregiver-mediated interventions (CMIs) are evidence-based and appropriate for toddlers with autism or early social communication challenges. The Social ABCs, one such CMI, is supported by robust evidence.

pmc-12607385.title: Sleep Trajectories in Amnestic and Non-Amnestic MCI: Longitudinal Insights from Subjective and Objective Assessments

Methods: In a three-wave longitudinal design (~24 months), 179 older adults (46 healthy controls [HCs], 75 aMCI, 58 naMCI; mean age = 70.2 years, education = 12.

pmc-12645040.title: B. adolescentis alleviates inflammation and suppresses PGE2 through remodling gut microbiota to attenuate pulmonary fibrosis in aging mice
pmc-12645040.creator: Jiali Ni, Fengjiao Wang, Yechen Wu, Jian Shen, Ziyuan Zhou, Lvwan Xu, Zhuoqi Lou, Yangfan Shen, Bo Qiu, Qiangqiang Xiang, Pengyu Yin, Yanfei Chen, Lanjuan Li
pmc-12645040.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The global burden of pulmonary fibrosis is increasing. Recent studies have shown that some pulmonary fibrotic lesions caused by COVID-19 infection may persist for a long time. Emerging evidence suggested a critical association between gut microbiota and pulmonary fibrosis. In this study, the clinical follow-up data from post-COVID-19 patients indicated that those with higher CT image scores were older, had a significantly lower Blautia and Bifidobacterium to Streptococcus ratio (B/S index).

pmc-12828159.title: Dual-drug nanocarriers for gout therapy: targeted co-delivery of anti-inflammatory and urate-lowering agents: a review
pmc-12828159.creator: Nisha Rata Karusan, Hairul Anuar Tajuddin, Nor Azlin Mat Radi, Rumman Karimah, Pratiwi Soesilawati, Syed Mahmood, Noraini Ahmad
pmc-12828159.description: Gout, a prevalent form of inflammatory arthritis, arises from the deposition of monosodium urate crystals in joints due to chronic hyperuricemia. Current pharmacologic monotherapies such as xanthine oxidase inhibitors, uricosurics, NSAIDs, corticosteroids, and colchicine are often limited by inadequate dual-action efficacy, suboptimal bioavailability, and systemic side effects.

pmc-13041230.title: The effect of dietary approaches to stop hypertension (DASH) diet on cardiometabolic and atherogenic indices in subjects with metabolic syndrome: a randomized clinical trial
pmc-13041230.creator: Xun Wei, Alireza Takzare, Rafat Rezapour-Nasrabad, Abbas Ali Sangouni, Mahdieh Hosseinzadeh, Karim Parastouei
pmc-13041230.description: BackgroundDietary approaches to stop hypertension (DASH) diet as a balanced dietary pattern is designed to help manage hypertension. The scientific evidence hypothesized that following the DASH diet may lead to reductions in cardiometabolic risk. We aimed to design a clinical trial to assess the impact of the DASH diet on cardiometabolic and atherogenic indices in individuals with metabolic syndrome (MetS).

pmc-13098351.title: Methodological development and validation of the Thai traditional medicine-based depression care program for older adults
pmc-13098351.creator: Sunatta Nonghang, Naruwat Pakdee, Ronnachai Poowanna
pmc-13098351.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). This article describes a detailed, validated protocol for a Thai traditional medicine (TTM) based care program developed for older adults with moderate depressive symptoms. Developed from TTM principles and contemporary evidence, the 7-week program integrates three modalities sequentially in weekly 60-minute sessions: herbal steam therapy (30 min), followed by combined receptive music therapy (slow-tempo, ∼60 bpm) and lavender aromatherapy oil massage (30 min total).

pmc-13491060.creator: Zhao Yang, Congmin Xu

pmc-13601827.title: Gut microbiota dysbiosis aggravates liver injury in acute-on-chronic liver failure through D-lactate accumulation
pmc-13601827.creator: Zhiwu Zeng, Lining Xu, Mingqing Yang, Weiyu Wang
pmc-13601827.description: IntroductionAcute-on-chronic liver failure (ACLF) is a life-threatening condition arising from the abrupt worsening of pre-existing chronic liver disease, typically accompanied by multi-organ failure and markedly elevated short-term mortality. Gut microbiota dysbiosis is frequently observed in patients with ACLF, yet the mechanisms by which microbial alterations contribute to disease progression remain unclear.
